title: 8-Day Ionian Greece Tour: Kefalonia & Zakynthos
metaDescription: Travel from Athens to Kefalonia and Zakynthos on an 8-day Ionian adventure featuring coastal landscapes, island experiences and guided sightseeing.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
Greece Tours & Packages 2026–2027 | Private & Island Hopping
summary:
The 8-Day Athens, Kefalonia & Zakynthos Tour pairs time in the Greek capital with two Ionian islands known for very different coastal landscapes. Begin in Athens with the Acropolis and the city’s ancient heritage, then fly to Kefalonia for its beaches, mountain scenery and small seaside villages. Continue by ferry to Zakynthos, where the coastline is shaped by sea caves, limestone cliffs and clear Ionian waters.
Operating from April to October, the journey follows seasonal island connections. The program covers selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, ferry tickets, airport and port transfers, and scheduled sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in after 13:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Athens City tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Flight to Kefalonia
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to the airport for your flight to Kefalonia.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Kefalonia.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Kefalonia
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day in Kefalonia. Visit the Melissani Cave and its beautiful underground lake, relax at Myrtos Beach, and explore the traditional villages of Fiskardo and Assos. Overnight in Kefalonia.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Zakynthos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Zakynthos.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Zakynthos.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Zakynthos
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free morning in Zakynthos. We recommend visiting the famous Navagio Beach with its iconic shipwreck, or exploring the beautiful Blue Caves near Cape Skinari. Overnight in Zakynthos..

itinerary.title: Flight to Athens
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to the airport for your flight to Athens.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 8-Day Tour Athens, Kefalonia & Zakynthos?
faqs.a: The 8-Day Tour Athens, Kefalonia & Zakynthos covers Athens and two of Greece's most beautiful Ionian Islands, Kefalonia and Zakynthos. You will explore Athens' ancient landmarks, discover Kefalonia's stunning beaches and charming villages, and experience Zakynthos' famous turquoise waters, dramatic cliffs, and picturesque coastline. The tour runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 8-Day Tour Athens, Kefalonia & Zakynthos cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,975 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic flights, speed ferry tickets, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers specified in the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights and ferry tickets included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes domestic flights and speed ferry tickets between destinations as outlined in the itinerary. These transportation arrangements provide a convenient and efficient way to explore Athens and the beautiful Ionian Islands.

faqs.q: Are international flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, international flights are not included in the tour price. Travelers are responsible for arranging their own flights to and from Greece. Magnificent Travel can assist with itinerary planning and travel recommendations if needed.

faqs.q: Does the 8-day Greece tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while helping you make the most of your Greek island holiday.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for travelers seeking a combination of history, island scenery, and relaxation. It offers an excellent introduction to Athens while showcasing the natural beauty and laid-back atmosphere of Kefalonia and Zakynthos.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historic districts, coastal villages, ferry ports, and sightseeing areas. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate in the itinerary.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Kefalonia and Zakynthos?
faqs.a: Kefalonia is famous for Myrtos Beach, Melissani Cave, picturesque fishing villages, and stunning coastal scenery. Zakynthos is renowned for Navagio (Shipwreck) Beach, the Blue Caves, crystal-clear waters, sea turtles, and beautiful seaside landscapes that make it one of Greece's most popular islands.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Athens, Kefalonia & Zakynthos Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, transportation conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 8-Day Tour Athens, Kefalonia & Zakynthos available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules and flight availability. You can extend your stay in Athens, Kefalonia, or Zakynthos, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
